evidence_checked: genuine claim diffed against the blind version: only operative_clauses[0].first_end.date differs (1978-07-01)
jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_12067.txt (section 1-101 'shall be effective on July 1, 1978'; all 25 clause texts read against their judgment reasons)
reasoning: The genuine version ends section 1-101 on 1978-07-01, the date the clause itself fixes, consistent with its reasons. I read all 25 clause texts against their judgment reasons and found them accurate. The single held amendment (EO 12107 substituting the Office of Personnel Management, effective January 1, 1979) is placed on section 1-302, the only clause naming the Civil Service Commission, and EO 13583 is correctly treated as a recital. The dossier's machine lead of a 'rescission 2017-01-03' comes from the EEOC's January 3, 2017 rule, whose held text uses 'rescind' only in quoting 42 U.S.C. 2000e-12(a) and invokes EO 12067 as continuing rulemaking authority, so no partial end exists. The rationale says this conflict 'is resolved in conflict_resolutions', a field the claim does not carry. That is a presentation gap, but the rationale itself supplies the resolution (the 2017 rule invokes the order as continuing authority), so I do not treat it as a defect. No held instrument revokes the order.
